chalisa.do1: In the month of Vaiśākha, joined with the Kṛttikā lunar mansion, to take away the burden of the earth, on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, a Monday, Narasiṃha took his avatāra.
chalisa.do2: Blessed is your lion's body, blessed is your name. Lord, by remembering you every undertaking is fulfilled.
chalisa.cau1: Lord Narasiṃha, I remember you; grant me the gift of wealth, strength and learning. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Victory, victory to Narasiṃha the merciful; ever protect your devotees. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: You are the merciful avatāra of Viṣṇu; you are Mahākāla, and the Death even of deaths. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Many names of yours are told; I, of little understanding, know nothing. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: King Hiraṇyakaśipu was exceedingly proud; under his weight the earth was in distress. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: The son born of Hiraṇyakaśipu and Kayādhū was called by the name Prahlāda, the devotee. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: He became a devotee, a servant of Viṣṇu; his father tried to kill him. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: He struck him with missiles and weapons and with the might of his arms, and burned him in a fierce fire. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: For your devotee's sake you took your avatāra, to crush the wicked and take away the earth's burden. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: You belong to your devotees, and your devotees to you; you are as dear to Prahlāda as his life. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: You appeared, tearing open the pillar; seeing it, the band of the wicked was struck with amazement. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Your tongue is like a sword, and your handsome body is arrayed; your hair stands on end, and your great fangs gleam. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Your face is like refined gold; who could describe your vastness? ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Your form is four-armed and your face is vast; your claws and tongue are most dreadful. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: You wear a golden crown, and your face is very large; the earrings in your ears are of a rare beauty. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: You rescued your devotee Prahlāda and slew the wicked Hiraṇyakaśipu in a moment. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Brahmā and Viṣṇu meditate on you every day; Indra and Śiva always fix their minds on you. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: The Vedas and Purāṇas sing your glory; Śeṣa and Sarasvatī cannot reach its end. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Whoever holds you in meditation always fares well. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Save, save, Lord, and take away sorrow; Lord, please remove the bonds of worldly existence yourself. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Whoever chants your name every day is delivered from sorrow and disease. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: One without children who has the chanting performed gains the son his heart desires. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: A childless woman gains good offspring, and a poor man becomes rich. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: To whoever has the chanting of Narasiṃha performed, no calamity comes even in a dream. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Whatever wish one makes in the mind, all of it is surely fulfilled. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Whatever trouble comes in life, let one surely remember Narasiṃha. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: If anyone stricken with disease meditates on him, his body becomes like gold. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Ḍākinīs and Śākinīs, ghosts and vetālas, the afflictions of the planets, disease and dreadful Yama, ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: ghosts and piśācas: all are afraid, and Yama's messengers do not come near. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: By remembering the name every ailment flees; disease and sorrow never touch one. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Brother, whoever suffers from the evil eye should sing the Narasiṃha Chālīsā. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: The evil eye is lifted and all is well; this word is true, and the Lord is witness. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Whoever fixes his meditation on you gains the fruit his heart desires. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: The wise man who has a temple built is honoured in the world. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Whoever recites it once every day remains dear to you. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: If anyone sings the Narasiṃha Chālīsā, sorrow and poverty do not come near him. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Whoever reads the Chālīsā and teaches it to others gains everything in the world. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: This is the Śrī Narasiṃha Chālīsā; by reading it a pauper becomes a king. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Whoever meditates finds happiness; one who turns away from you suffers much sorrow. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Your refuge is blessing itself; Lord, take away all our calamities. ॥40॥
chalisa.do3: All four ages sing your boundless glory. For the lives of your own devotees you took your avatāra in the world.
chalisa.do4: When one reads the Narasiṃha Chālīsā a hundred times, absorbed in love, joy abides in that home and wealth grows without bound.
